summary: Xanadu Quantum Technologies Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a standby equity purchase agreement with YA II PN, Ltd. (Yorkville). Under the agreement, Xanadu has the right, but not obligation, to sell up to $300M of its subordinate voting shares to Yorkville over time, at 97.5% of the market price. No mandatory minimum sales exist. The filing is not a standalone special situation; it is an at-the-market equity facility. Watch for future drawdowns and potential dilution.
